newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Sanonda to issue A share dividend.
newsitem.headline: China's Sanonda to issue A share dividend.

text.p: China's Hubei Sanonda Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would make an after-tax cash payment of 0.28 yuan per domestic currency A share as a dividend based on 1996 profits.
The firm said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times that the registration deadline for the 1996 dividend was July 18 and its A shares would go ex-dividend on July 21.

The pesticide maker, which listed 100 million foreign currency B shares on the Shenzhen exchange in May, posted net profits of 77.61 million yuan for 1996 against 50.36 million yuan in 1995 under Chinese accounting standards.
